'''January 2000 Boca Raton tournament (23 January)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Boca Raton, Florida on 23 January 2000. [[David Akers]] won it. It is known from Mike Fitzgerald's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d198">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-titans-boca-raton-florida-1-23-00d198/ titans-boca-raton-florida-1-23-00], DeckTech (Mike "Iceman" Fitzgerald, 23 January 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-01-23-titans-boca-raton-florida-1-23-00d198/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 23 January 2000
* '''Site:''' Boca Raton, Florida
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' [[David Akers]]
